voice.name: Voice mode
voice.talkTitle: Hold to talk, release to send. Or tap, speak, and pause.
voice.question: Answer by voice, or on the card.
voice.idleCaption: Hold Talk, or press Enter, and speak to {{name}}.

notice.noMatch: Not understood: say the number of a choice.
notice.speechFailed: The voice could not speak. The reply is in the chat.
notice.answerOnScreen: Answer not sent: use the card on screen.

spoken.approval: I need your approval. Look at the screen.
spoken.noMatch: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Say the number of your choice.
spoken.multiSelect: Answer on the screen: there are several choices.

settings.title: Voice mode
settings.stepsHint: The bot also says the short lines it writes before working ("I'm looking it up…").
settings.voicesHint: Better voices are free: System Settings > Accessibility > Read & Speak > System voice, then download a Premium voice.
settings.handsFreeHint: After each reply, the microphone reopens for 8 seconds while the window is in front, for 10 minutes at most after your last click. Leaving the window ends it.

voice.handsFreeTitle: Hands-free: after each reply the microphone reopens for a few seconds. Off: hold Talk for each sentence.
voice.standby: Standby. Press Talk or Enter to go on.
